project_type: Python 3.12 FastAPI application - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
build_system: setuptools with pyproject.toml, pip install -e '.[dev]'. Must use pyenv local 3.12.13 first.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (auto mode). Tests in tests/ directory. Uses AsyncMock for DB sessions, fixture-based (conftest.py).
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure pyenv local 3.12.13 is set. 2. pip install -e '.[dev]'. 3. python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short. All 600+ tests must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: alembic/versions/ contains auto-generated migration scripts. Initial migration already exists.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12+ required (use pyenv local 3.12.13). OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No Docker daemon needed for tests. PostgreSQL not required for tests (tests use mocks).
contribution_requirements: ruff formatted (100 char line length), type hints on all functions, docstrings on all public classes/methods, follow existing adapter Protocol interface, do not modify dashboard/frontend
key_patterns: Adapters extend BaseAdapter (ABC) with _do_create_session, _do_execute, _do_heartbeat, _do_terminate hooks. Registry pattern for adapter types. SQLModel for DB models. pydantic-settings for config. ASGI middleware for governance.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. Sub-packages: adapters/, api/ (routes/, middleware), governance/, models/, runtime/, communication/, company/, demo/, evolution/, identity/, knowledge/, meetings/, memory/, orchestration/, services/, tools/, triggers/, workflows/. Tests in tests/ at project root. Alembic migrations in alembic/versions/.
